stdout:
Subscribe to a channel. Use this tool to subscribe to a YouTube channel.

Usage:
  yutu subscription insert [flags]

Examples:
# Subscribe to a channel
yutu subscription insert --subscriberChannelId UC_abc --channelId UC_x5XG1OV2P6uZZ5FSM9Ttw
# Subscribe with a title
yutu subscription insert --subscriberChannelId UC_abc --channelId UC_x5X --title 'Google Developers'

Flags:
  -c, --channelId string             ID of the channel to subscribe to
  -d, --description string           Description of the subscription
  -h, --help                         help for insert
  -o, --output string                json|yaml|silent
  -s, --subscriberChannelId string   Subscriber's channel id
  -t, --title string                 Title of the subscription
      --yes                          Confirm the operation
